correctness.rationale: The claim is fully quantified for integer r>=2 and all a_i>=2 with fixed standard coordinate metric. Every facet is L,U or adjacent equality; compatible two-facet intersections are exhausted by the four ridge classes. Disjoint/overlapping exclusions are forced by extra ties. Simplex-order Jacobians 1,sqrt2,sqrt3,2 and multiplicities cancel layer factors, giving normalized ridge totals 2,2k sqrt2,k sqrt3,k(k-1). Exterior normal angles pi/2 or pi/3 and the polyhedral Steiner ridge formula yield the exact coefficient. Independent convex-hull face measure computations on 16 profiles/1356 ridges agreed, but finite checks alone do not establish the general proof.

value.rationale: The two first Euclidean outer-parallel coefficients per volume are the natural metric boundary invariants for these canonical order polytopes. The cancellation is structural and holds for infinitely many noncongruent profiles; fixed dimension 8 and r=3, profiles (2,2,4) and (2,3,3) have different facet counts 18 and 20 yet equal both normalized invariants. This is a complete nontrivial exact invariance classification within a natural published family, rather than an arbitrary finite table.
